name: Public works contracts
review_status: Article numbers read in a consolidated text of Ν. 4412/2016 that includes amendments up to Ν. 5149/2024; the order of the cascade checked against the arithmetic of a published municipal budget. Pending review by a Greek public works engineer.
references: Ν. 4412/2016 (ΦΕΚ Α 147/08.08.2016), Δημόσιες Συμβάσεις Έργων, Προμηθειών και Υπηρεσιών (https://www.taxheaven.gr/law/4412/2016)
Ν. 4412/2016 art. 53 §7θ, ΓΕ&ΟΕ 18 percent, and art. 156 §3α, απρόβλεπτα 9 or 15 percent (consolidated text https://eadhsy.gr/n4412/n4412fulltextlinks.html)
Example of the cascade in a published municipal budget (https://messolonghi.gov.gr/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/%CE%9C%CE%B5%CE%BB%CE%AD%CF%84%CE%B7-48_2019.pdf)
description: Public works in Greece are procured under Ν. 4412/2016. The budget prices the works from the ΝΕΤ articles, adds general expenses and contractor profit (ΓΕ&ΟΕ) at 18 percent, then contingency (απρόβλεπτα) on the works plus ΓΕ&ΟΕ at 15 percent for a contract below the EU threshold or 9 percent at or above it, then any cost-plus items and the price revision allowance, and ΦΠΑ at 24 percent on the whole. Bidders usually tender a discount per group of works on the authority's budget.
practice_notes: The pack's cascade carries 18 percent ΓΕ&ΟΕ and 15 percent απρόβλεπτα; set the contingency to 9 percent on a contract at or above the EU threshold
Αναθεώρηση, the price revision allowance, is a lump sum computed from published index coefficients and is not a percentage of the works
The tender discount (έκπτωση) belongs to tender evaluation, not to the authority's budget
